lighthouse.title: Lighthouse, in plain English
lighthouse.text:
**Lighthouse is Google’s free tool that gives your website a health check.** It goes over it from top to bottom and hands back four scores out of 100: the same kind of test Google uses to judge whether your website gives visitors a good experience.

Every website I build leaves my desk **tested with Lighthouse**. A perfect 100 isn’t about bragging rights: it’s the simplest way to prove the job was done right, with a number you can check for yourself.
lighthouse.imageAlt: Illustration of a website with four Lighthouse scores of 100 and Core Web Vitals in the green

scores.title: Performance
scores.text: **How fast your website is.** Think of a shop door that opens the moment you walk up: make customers wait and they walk away. According to Google, over half of mobile visitors leave if a page takes more than 3 seconds to load.

scores.title: Accessibility
scores.text: **Everyone can use it**, including people with low vision or who browse with only a keyboard or a screen reader. It’s the right thing to do, it reaches more customers and, since 28 June 2025, the European Accessibility Act makes it a legal requirement for many businesses selling online in the EU.

scores.title: Best practices
scores.text: **It’s built to professional standards.** A secure connection (HTTPS), no hidden errors, up-to-date components, images in the right format. Like wiring that’s up to code: you never see it, but it makes all the difference.

scores.title: SEO
scores.text: **Google gets what you do.** Titles, descriptions, page structure and links, all in order. It’s the technical groundwork: without it, even great content goes unseen.

lighthouse.cwvText: Three measurements Google takes from the **real people** visiting your website, and one of the signals it uses for rankings. In short: speed, responsiveness and stability.

cwv.title: LCP · speed
cwv.text: How long the main content takes to show up

cwv.title: INP · responsiveness
cwv.text: How quickly the page reacts to a tap or click

cwv.title: CLS · stability
cwv.text: How much the page “jumps” as it loads (that button you keep missing)

lighthouse.testText: Type in your web address to open PageSpeed Insights, Google’s official Lighthouse-based tool. Seeing red or orange? **Let’s talk**.

seoSection.title: SEO: be found by the people already looking for you
seoSection.text: Every day, someone searches Google for exactly what you sell. SEO makes sure they find **you**, not a competitor. And unlike ads, the results keep coming after you stop paying. **On the websites I build, SEO is part of the foundations**; if you already have a website, SEO consulting picks up from there.
seoSection.imageAlt: Illustration of a Google results page with your website in first place

about.title: The person behind your website
about.text:
I’m Antonio, and I’ve been building and fine-tuning websites for over 15 years. I worked my way up at web agencies abroad, from *junior developer* to *senior* to *lead developer*, running the development team. I went freelance in 2016 and now work with businesses and agencies alike.

I’ve always treated **speed, SEO and clean code** as part of the job, not an optional extra. Today I put that experience to work for people who want to grow online and see the results in numbers, bringing in AI where it genuinely helps.

I grew up in Friuli and live in Veneto, in northeast Italy. Eleven years abroad left me fluent in **English, German and Spanish**, so I can support your project in international markets too.

items.question: How much does a website cost?
items.answer: It depends on how many pages and features you need. After a free call and an initial review I send you a **fixed-price** quote that already covers SEO, speed, accessibility, tracking and training: no hidden costs. Consulting and ad management are fixed-price too, never a percentage of your ad spend.

items.question: What’s included in the website?
items.answer: Everything a website needs to work: custom design, copy, development, technical and local SEO, Lighthouse optimization, accessibility, Google Analytics and Tag Manager with Consent Mode, privacy and cookies sorted, launch and training. AI features such as a customer assistant can be added whenever you need them.

items.question: How soon will I see results?
items.answer: Speed gains show up in Lighthouse straight away, and in Google’s real-visitor data within about a month. Google Ads campaigns start giving you data within days. SEO is an investment: solid results usually take 3 to 6 months, and then they last.

items.question: Do I need a brand-new website?
items.answer: Not necessarily. An existing website can very often be sped up and fixed for SEO for far less than a rebuild. If starting over really is the better option, I’ll tell you and explain why.

items.question: Why should I care about my Lighthouse score?
items.answer: Because it measures things that hit your revenue: a slow website loses visitors, a website with poor accessibility shuts out customers (and may no longer be compliant), a website with technical issues struggles on Google. It’s also an objective way to check anyone’s work, mine included.

items.question: Can AI really help a small business?
items.answer: Yes, when it solves a specific problem: answering customers faster, cutting repetitive work, getting found on ChatGPT. We always start from a real use case and measure the time or money saved. If it isn’t worth it, we don’t do it.

items.question: Do I keep the website and the accounts?
items.answer: Always. Domain, hosting, code, Google and ad accounts are in your name. You can switch providers whenever you like, no strings attached.

items.question: Do you work remotely and with clients abroad?
items.answer: Yes. I’m based in Veneto, Italy, and happy to meet clients in Veneto and Friuli in person, but I work remotely with clients across Italy and abroad, in English, Italian, German and Spanish.
